svg.title: Lite node agent connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Lite node agent.

a.xlink:title: Identity, authentication, and invite guards. Applies identity guards, duplicate checks, protected-host checks, and fail-closed invite/bootstrap acceptance.
Device command executor. Executes approved device commands in the node agent and publishes truthful results.
a.text: in the node agent and publishes

a.xlink:title: Reconnect watchdog and supervisor recovery. Separates running-but-disconnected recovery from stopped-agent recovery and exposes truthful guidance when no supervisor is available.
Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers. Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
